newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant resumes full power.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant resumes full power.

text.p: Washington Public Power Supply System's 1,158 megawatt (MW) nuclear power plant was operating at full power Tuesday following a reduction for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
Power was reduced to 54 percent at the WNP2 plant last week to correct a problem with the motor for the plant's adjustable speed drive system.
The plant, located in Richland, Wash., was operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
